outcome: Time to initiation of antenatal care (ANC)
cohort: 2933 women aged 15-49 years in Ethiopia who had ANC visits during their current or most recent pregnancy within the 5 years prior to the survey
finding: Women in the study area initiated ANC later than recommended, with cesarean section history and higher education associated with earlier initiation, while grand multiparity, previous union, home birth, and rural residence were associated with later initiation.
mod_finding: Women whose last birth was a caesarean section had a shorter time to initiate ANC early in the first trimester of pregnancy.
gest_age: Gestational age at first ANC visit was recorded
